title: Positioning spikes (rare hourly events, Gen348 engine: z vs trailing 720 h lagged, |z| > 3, 4 h hold, 0.1 per coin) - 3 trials

trials.A open-interest spike fade: hourly log change of open interest value (20 pack coins from metrics, 40 extra coins from their hourly OI files); |z| > 3 -> position = -sign(that hour's price return) (fade the move that came with the leverage jump)
trials.B top-trader crowding: 20 pack coins, hourly change of sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio (metrics, from 2021-12); z > 3 -> short, z < -3 -> long
trials.C taker volume ratio spike: 20 pack coins, hourly mean of sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio; z > 3 -> short, z < -3 -> long

bars: as Gen349 (DEV is 2020-22 or from the data start; TEST >= 0.8; HOLD >= 0.5; |corr v8.6| <= 0.2; |corr premium-spike sleeve| <= 0.5)
